name: waluipedia-local-agent
description: Bounded local planning, repository review, and ComfyUI image generation.

tools.name: run_agent_loop
tools.side_effects: executes only allowlisted local tools; patches and image jobs require explicit approval

tools.name: plan_large_request
tools.side_effects: writes an ignored checkpoint under tools/.local-agent-runs

tools.name: repo_search
tools.side_effects: none; bounded result count and file size

tools.name: repo_patch
tools.side_effects: one exact-match local file patch; no Git operation

tools.name: queue_qwen_image_edit
tools.side_effects: uploads references to local ComfyUI and queues one image job
